model.name: T-room-symlink: room.json as symlink to canonical scenario unit + one-shot backfill
model.description: Every data/users/<u>/rooms/<r>/room.json becomes a symlink to scenario/index/<shard>/<r>.scenario.json. One-shot backfill script converts existing standalone room.json files. After backfill, Room.persist writes to the canonical unit; the symlink resolves transparently. Covers R19.22.A.
